messages.subject: Re: facet labels in qplot
parts:
It would really help to have some sample data .  See ?dput.

On Friday, July 20, 2012 7:38:47 PM UTC-4, Matt Jordan wrote:
I made a plot with gender as a facet and injury as a factor.  For gender, I just went through my dataset and changed gender from a numeric value to "male" and female" to increase clarity in my graph.  When I was experimenting with the graph I managed to get a nice plot when I also included Injury as a facet.

I would like to change my facet label for  injury status from the numeric value to the "healthy" and "injured".  I'm sure there is a way to do this with a command in qplot but I'm stuck.

Here is my command:

qplot(factor(INJURY), PPSJ, facets=INJURY~GENDER, , data=DATA,size=BADEXA) + xlab("Injury Status (1=Healthy, 2=ACL Injured)") +labs(size = "BA Lean Muscle") + ylab("PEAK POWER SQUAT JUMP (W)")

Any help would be appreciated.

Matt
